Hero_Desc_Rufo:
An arrogant werebeast.
Although she always acts detestably, it doesn't seem like all her relationships are bad since she has close friends.
She calls herself the brains behind the Chow Rebels.
Album_Like_Rufo: Her plans coming true as imagined. Heroic novels.
Album_Hate_Rufo: The barriers of reality. Mint herbs.
Album_Wish_Rufo: Having strength equal to her intelligence.
Album_Rufo1: A werebeast of many talents. Extremely crafty and mischievous, Rufo loves playing pranks. She may seem rude at first, but once you get to know her, you realize her personality is vivacious and full of harmless fun, that you can laugh about. Her laughter can be... well, it's something else.
Album_Rufo2: Tig is a werebeast who is a great match for Rufo. Rufo looks up to Tig as a role model and even tries to learn swordsmanship from her, but resorts to using a dagger since the sword is too heavy to be handled properly.
Album_Rufo3: Recently, it was discovered that Tig and Rufo have immersed themselves in some kind of role-playing. If Tig is proclaimed to be the 'strongest swordsman in Werebeast Village,' then Rufo is 'Tig's mighty right hand.' Since this play acting doesn't depend on a time or a place, thing may get awkward around their friends, as it may appear as if they are arguing.
Album_Rufo4: Rufo is smarter and wiser than one might think. She has a knack for subtly manipulating conversations to steer the werebeasts she hangs out with to do what she wants, with or without their knowledge. It almost feels like she's brain of the group, don't you think?
Album_Rufo5: The elder, Diana, says whenever there's trouble at the Werebeast Village, Tig is often at the forefront, but Rufo is always at the back. Even when if it's Rufo who flees, she's so good that Tig ends up being the one caught and reprimanded...
Album_Rufo6: As clever as Rufo is, she's equally skilled in deception. She once convinced me she was 'kidnapped by the elves made into a cyborg werebeast.' Now that I think about it, it's an absurd story, but somehow, before I knew it, I found myself believing her.
Album_Rufo7: Judging from Rufo's abilities... it's possible that Rufo is the reason Tig developed her paranoia. One day, I should have a serious talk with Rufo and at least make sure she doesn't lie when dealing with Tig.

no one can

Food_ChefNote_Rufo_Hate1: Rufo dissed me, saying that this fake dish was made entirely from natural ingredients and thus lacked both intelligence and sincerity.
Food_ChefNote_Rufo_Hate2: Rufo seemed to detest the musty scent coming from this dish.
Food_ChefNote_Rufo_Like1:
After taking a bite, Rufo said the dressing was excellent since it whetted her appetite.
She asked me not to tell the other members of Chow Rebels she had eaten it.
Food_ChefNote_Rufo_Like2: As she ate it, Rufo said the taste of this dish reminded her of a very good friend who is a bit of a sucker.
Food_ChefNote_Rufo_Like3: Rufo, tired from playing all night, liked the food, saying it relieved her fatigue.
Food_ChefNote_Rufo_Like4: She stuffed them by the handfuls into her pockets, saying, 'If I don't bring any to my Captain, she'll kill me.'
Food_ChefNote_Rufo_Like5: Rufo insisted that it was a brain-stimulating food, essential for the Chow Rebel's diet.
Food_ChefNote_Rufo_Like6: Rufo played by wildly stabbing it with a dagger, thinking it was a log. If she's having fun, that's all that matters.
Food_ChefNote_Rufo_Like7: Rufo found the idea of aging intriguing. She ate too much and got a stomachache.
Food_ChefNote_Rufo_Like8: Rufo might think this is a smoke bomb. She threw it around, turning the Banquet Hall into a mess.
Food_ChefNote_Rufo_Like9: Rufo loves how they melt gently just like a tongue in your mouth. I don't think it's the right expression to use but... It's cute, so let's leave it at that.

LoveCall_Rufo:
Master! It is I, Rufo~!
Have you considered appointing a strategist? If you desire it, I could graciously serve as both the brains of the Chow Rebels and strategist of the Order!

Hmm? You ask why I suddenly decided to become a strategist?
The thought simply occurred to me... that I am a l-little grateful to you, Master.
You always listen to my worries and have done many things for our village.
Therefore, I have personally decided to help you. I am intelligent, so I will certainly prove useful!

Then, Master, once you decide the date when I will begin my work at the Order, inform me.
I refuse your refusal~!
